Choose a visible water square beside the target and make a Reason control attack.

2 physical damage; pull 1 square toward that water square.
Standard
3 physical damage and Slowed 1; pull 2 squares toward it.
Strong
5 physical damage, Slowed 1 and Prone; pull 3 squares toward it.
